message.content: On September 23, 2026, WolfgangSchulz proposes meeting at 5:30 PM to go grocery shopping with LiHua. This suggestion comes from a conversation where WolfgangSchulz initiates the idea by saying, "How about around 5:30? We can get there before it gets too crowded! 🛒". LiHua agrees with the time, stating, "5:30 works for me! Looking forward to it! 😄".
